host.displayName: Map of AI — The 2036 Textbook Atlas

entries.description: Public Agent2Agent (A2A) endpoint for Map of AI (mapofai.dev). External agents can query the 517-milestone catalog, propose primary-sourced milestones, submit citation or placement corrections, and suggest directed lineage connections for maintainer review. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <github_token>` (`read:user` scope, GitHub account age >= 30 days) on all `POST /a2a` requests.
representativeQueries: Propose adding 'Direct Preference Optimization' (2023.5) to province alignment-interpretability-plateau with primary citation https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.18290 by Rafailov et al.
Search the atlas for milestones related to A2A Protocol and Transformers.
Propose a directed lineage road from 'lecun_convnet_1989' to 'alexnet_2012'.

auth.instructions: Supply an HTTP header `Authorization: Bearer <github_token>` with `read:user` scope (zero repository write scopes required) on all `POST /a2a` JSON-RPC calls.
